system.description:
Critical Mass: While Unleashed, your successful attack rolls gain the following features:

  • Crushing Force: The target must mark a Stress.

  • Disintegrate: When you deal Severe damage, spend an Echo to let the target mark an additional Hit Point.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: Spend Echo from the class feature that holds it: the system can only charge a cost to the resource on the same item, so this Echo cost is paid by hand.
